## Why Master Location?

**Problem**: Each project (irStudy, year9-platform, etc.) had DUPLICATE PRD standards files
**Solution**: Single source of truth in `ralph-dashboard` master project
**Benefit**: Update once, all projects reference the same standards

---

## T-RALPH Structure (Quick Reference)

```
T - TESTS (Test Specification - Write These FIRST)
R - REQUEST (User Story & Business Context)
A - ARCHITECTURE (Technical Approach)
L - LOOP (Iterative Development with TDD Enforcement)
P - PLAN (Detailed Implementation)
H - HANDOFF (Delivery & Validation)
```

**Key Principle**: ALL tests embedded in PRD as executable code (50-100 lines each), NOT in separate documents

**TDD Workflow**: RED (tests fail) → GREEN (tests pass) → REFACTOR (improve while maintaining 100% pass rate)

---

## irStudy Project Examples

**PRDs Following T-RALPH** (created before master standards existed):
- `PRD-P1-006-FLASHCARD-REVIEW-INTERFACE.md` - 29 tests (100% pass rate)
- `PRD-P1-007-SM2-REVIEW-LOGIC.md` - 22 tests (100% pass rate)

**What Led to T-RALPH**:
- These PRDs were created with R-A-L-P-H structure
- Tests documented in SEPARATE file: `COMPREHENSIVE-TESTING-PLAN-STUDY-CARDS.md`
- Lesson learned: Tests should be IN the PRD, not separate
- Result: T-RALPH structure created (tests embedded in PRD)
